text:
Priya (People Ops): Heads-up — candidate Lina (SWE IC) has an ask: she wants her pension enrollment to start on her first day (2025-10-06) instead of standard first-of-month after 30 days. Is that an exception we can make?
Olivia (Recruiter): She accepted last night. Relocating from UK -> US, start 2025-10-06. Candidate requested pension start day for continuity with previous plan.
Raj (Hiring Manager): We really need her to start Oct 6 for the feature kickoff. Can we fast-track pension so benefits kick in day one? :thinking:
Lenny (Comp): Policy summary: standard is enrollment effective first of the month after 30 days of employment. Backdating or day-one enrollment is an exception and has payroll/tax implications for cross-border hires.
Sam (Finance): Quick calc — employer match pro-rated if we enroll mid-pay-cycle. If we backdate to day one and process contributions retro, the org cost ~ +$1,150 one-time (estimate). Need approval for non-standard employer contribution timing.
Priya (People Ops): OK — this looks like a comp/finance exception. Routing proposal: 1) Lenny to sign off on comp risk, 2) Finance (Sam) to confirm cost and tax ops, 3) People Ops lead (me) for policy variance, 4) VP HR final sign-off. If all agree we can instruct payroll.
Lenny (Comp): I can sign for comp committee if cost < $2k and no precedent risk. I need the candidate's band and target comp.
Olivia (Recruiter): Band: IC3, OTE broken down as "base: $160k, sign-on: $15k". Candidate asked to keep pension continuity, doesn't want a gap.
Sam (Finance): Confirming we can absorb up to $2k without escalating. Payroll will need a stub adjustment and tax paperwork for retro contributions — timeline 2 pay cycles. Approve route: send to payroll@redwood with CC to comp and people-ops once VP ok.
HR-Bot: Policy link: https://redwood.internal/people-ops/policies/pension-enrollment (automated) — current text: "enrollment effective: first of month after 30 service days; exceptions require VP HR + Finance approval."
Raj (Hiring Manager): I'm happy to absorb the $1.15k. Please move through approvals. Candidate will not accept a delayed enrollment.
Priya (People Ops): Action items: Olivia please confirm candidate accepts potential 2-pay-cycle payroll processing for retro contribution. Lenny — can you +1 comp exception? Sam — please confirm cost breakdown with payroll. I'll prepare VP sign-off note.
Olivia (Recruiter): Confirmed with Lina — she accepts the processing timeline and any paperwork.
Lenny (Comp): +1 from comp side given band and small cost.
Sam (Finance): I'll send exact cost and payroll steps by EOD and loop payroll team.
Priya (People Ops): Great — preparing exception memo for VP HR. Routing now: comp -> finance -> payroll -> VP HR. Will post update in thread when VP signs. :thumbsup:
